definition: NoBruteFoundation A w says no foundation at w is a contingent truth with no reason at w. NoUnreasonedFoundation A w removes the restriction to contingent stops: every foundation at w has some reason at w, possibly itself. Both are open candidate norms: no result asserts either, and each is tested against named models.
note: Analyst-stated as the candidate named in the owner follow-up on #746. No source is claimed; a sourced formulation would need a pinned or bibliographic witness.
